gallery.country_name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

text: Poles in Vienna and [Innsbruck](https://goo.gl/maps/MWpqa8t1cVzunLrz9) feature these **red**-and-**white **pieces of tape that look like the Austrian flag. They can be differentiated by the fact that the tapes in [Vienna](https://goo.gl/maps/N4tkGXcAt1sbjxNy7) are thinner, and there are typically two on each pole.
text_zh: 維也納和[因斯布魯克](https://goo.gl/maps/MWpqa8t1cVzunLrz9)的電線桿上帶有這些**紅**與**白**相間膠帶，看起來像奧地利國旗。兩者可以這樣區分：[維也納](https://goo.gl/maps/N4tkGXcAt1sbjxNy7)的膠帶較細，且每根電線桿上通常有兩條。

text: **Provincial flags** appear decently often. The [Fleurdelisé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Quebec) of Québec in particular is very common.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **省旗**相當常出現。特別是魁北克的[百合花旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Quebec)非常常見。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Acadia** is a French-speaking cultural region in the Canadian Maritimes without clearly defined borders. It is usually understood to at least include north and east New Brunswick, with some isolated communities in Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island.

It has its own flag, which is a French-style tricolour with a yellow star in the blue band. It can be seen either flown or painted on [poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4VfcnD6JmdyFURQD8) in this region.
text_zh: **阿卡迪亞**是加拿大海洋省份中一個沒有明確邊界的法語文化區。通常理解為至少包含紐布倫斯威克省北部與東部，以及新斯科細亞省和愛德華王子島的一些孤立社區。
它有自己的旗幟，是帶有黃色星星在藍條紋上的法式三色旗。在該地區可以看見這面旗幟懸掛或繪製在[電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4VfcnD6JmdyFURQD8)上。

text: Roads may be lined by tall rectangles on a stick in the colours of the Austrian flag, which are not found elsewhere.
text_zh: 道路兩旁可能會有漆成奧地利國旗顏色的長條狀細長矩形，這在其他地方是找不到的。

text: Most departments have their own unique logo (formally called official flag), often containing stylized initials or the entire name. Notable infrastructure with department logos include [bus stops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7), [kilometre markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9), [trail banners](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7), [directional signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6) and [signbacks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6). Learning what each logo looks like is not recommended for beginners, but it can be helpful to know what they stand for when scanning.

You can find the full list of logos [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments), or see them projected onto a map [here](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png).
text_zh: 大多數省份都有自己獨特的標誌（正式稱為官方旗幟），通常包含風格化的縮寫或全名。帶有省份標誌的知名基礎設施包括[公車站](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7)、[公里標石](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9)、[步道標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7)、[方向標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6)和[標誌背面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6)。不建議初學者學習每個標誌長什麼樣子，但在掃描時了解它們代表什麼會很有幫助。

你可以在[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments)找到標誌的完整列表，或在[這裡](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: A red and yellow logo with an [Occitan cross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_cross) and vertical stripes is the official flag of the Occitanie region.

The rest of the regions also have [logos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#Regions), which appear less frequently. You can see them projected onto a map [here](https://i.imgur.com/DNYKa4L.png).
text_zh: 一個帶有[奧克西坦尼十字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_cross)和垂直條紋的紅黃相間標誌是奧克西坦尼大區的官方旗幟。
其餘的大區也有[標誌](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#Regions)，但出現頻率較低。你可以在[這裡](https://i.imgur.com/DNYKa4L.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: A flag made up of red and yellow stripes, based on [the Senyera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera), is the official flag and department logo of **Pyrénées-Orientales**. You will often find the pattern used in coats of arms on street signs.
NOTE: The flag of [Provence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provence) looks similar, but with [vertical](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CWTzNJaQNoRJwEDeA) stripes instead.
text_zh: 一面由紅黃條紋組成、基於[塞涅拉旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera)的旗幟，是**東比利牛斯省**的官方旗幟和省份標誌。你經常會在路標的徽章上看到這種圖案。
注意：[普羅旺斯](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provence)的旗幟看起來很相似，但採用的是[垂直](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CWTzNJaQNoRJwEDeA)條紋。

text: On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.
NOTE: All pictured colourful antenna flags are unique to France.
text_zh: 在罕見的情況下，你可能會在相機世代 3（generation 3）覆蓋的天線上發現一面旗幟。雖然許多標示區域已被覆蓋更新，但了解每個天線的分佈可以獲得非常高的分數。
注意：所有照片中色彩繽紛的天線旗幟都是法國獨有的。

text: Poles in Indonesia are typically round and made out of either [**steel**](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA)** **or **concrete**. Many of the steel poles are painted black, and also feature the **Indonesian flag colours on them**. The pole tops are usually either [even](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA) or [uneven](https://goo.gl/maps/jA77LfkLbiz5AbK37), depending on the region.
_You can learn more about regional poles in the region-guessing section._
text_zh: 印尼的電線桿通常是圓形的，由[**鋼**](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA)**或****混凝土**製成。許多鋼製電線桿被漆成黑色，並且還具有**印尼國旗顏色**。桿頂通常是[平整的](https://goo.gl/maps/rnii3wodNEqzH2FDA)或[不平整的](https://goo.gl/maps/jA77LfkLbiz5AbK37)，取決於地區而定。
_你可以在地區猜測章節中了解更多關於地區電線桿的資訊。_

text: You can find these rows of red and white **banners **all around Indonesia. Sometimes, [more colourful flags](https://goo.gl/maps/iFwjZBmEWCbEcbvU9) can be found.
text_zh: 你可以在印尼各地找到這些一排排的紅白色**橫幅**。有時，可以找到[色彩更豐富的旗幟](https://goo.gl/maps/iFwjZBmEWCbEcbvU9)。

text: Each Italian region has its own unique flag.
text_zh: 每個義大利大區都有自己獨特的旗幟。

text: The Campione d'Italia **exclave** in Switzerland can be recognized by its low camera, having a long antenna and a flag. There is also a body of water to the west.

NOTE: This antenna can also be found in several areas in [Switzerland](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.8917308,9.0384397,3a,38.3y,19.25h,71.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0x8K6Xn3tuFsalTznE_BGw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656).
text_zh: 位於瑞士的坎皮奧內d'義大利（Campione d'Italia）**飛地**可以藉由其低相機、長天線和一面旗幟來識別。西部還有一個水域。
注意：這個天線也可以在[瑞士](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.8917308,9.0384397,3a,38.3y,19.25h,71.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0x8K6Xn3tuFsalTznE_BGw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)的幾個地區找到。

text: This style of **mailbox**, resting on top of a post and with a small flag on the side, is mostly associated with North America.
text_zh: 這種支撐在柱子上方、側邊帶有小旗子的**信箱**風格，主要與北美有關。

text: The tripod at the **south pole** can be recognized by numerous countries’ flags around the tripod, and a sign with ‘Geographic South Pole’ written on it.
This location is often on community-made world maps for a better scoring range.
text_zh: **南極點** 的三腳架街景，可以透過周圍許多國家的國旗，以及寫有「Geographic South Pole」字樣的標誌來辨識。
這個地點經常出現在社群製作的世界地圖上，以提供更好的計分範圍。

text: Each Austrian state has its own **unique flag**, shown in the image.
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利的每個邦都有其**獨特的旗幟**，如圖所示。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: In Lower Austria, you may find signs with **yellow and blue sign borders**, corresponding to the [flag of the region](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg/2560px-Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg.png).
text_zh: 在下奧地利州，你可能會看到帶有**黃藍相間標誌邊框**的標誌，這對應了[該地區的旗幟](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg/2560px-Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg.png)。

text: **Prayer flags** near the road are typically seen in Bhutan.
text_zh: 路邊的**經幡**是不丹常見的特徵。

text: Bolivia has a **second official flag**, called the [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala). It is a square patchwork of seven diagonally arranged colours. It is sometimes seen on government buildings and project signs.
text_zh: 玻利維亞有一面**第二官方國旗**，稱為 [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala)。它是一個由七種對角排列顏色組成的方形拼布旗幟。有時可以在政府大樓和工程標誌上看到它。

text: You can commonly see a small piece of **grey tape **at the top of the car antenna in Generation 3 coverage. The community sometimes refers to it as “flag antenna”.
Not all Gen 3 coverage has this tape.
NOTE: This can also be seen in Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, and Romania.
text_zh: 在 3 代街景覆蓋中，你經常可以看到車頂天線頂部貼著一小塊**灰色膠帶**。社群有時稱之為「旗幟天線」（flag antenna）。
並非所有的 3 代街景覆蓋都有這種膠帶。
注意：這在捷克、斯洛伐克、匈牙利和羅馬尼亞也能看到。

text: The majority of Cambodians are **Buddhist**. Temples are common throughout the country. Temple architecture is highly decorative, with ornamented roofs. You might also see [Buddhist flags](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag).
NOTE: Thailand and Laos are also majority Buddhist. Temples in these countries can look similar.
text_zh: 大多數柬埔寨人信仰**佛教**。寺廟遍布全國各地。寺廟建築極具裝飾性，帶有雕飾的屋頂。你也可能會看到[佛教旗幟](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag)。
注意：泰國和寮國也以佛教為主。這些國家的寺廟看起來可能很相似。

text: This style of mailbox, resting on top of a post and with a **small flag** on the side, is mostly associated with North America.
text_zh: 這種立在柱子上、側邊帶有**小旗子**的信箱樣式，主要與北美地區相關。

text: Each province has their own provincial flag.
text_zh: 每個省都有自己的省旗。

text: **Åland** is a group of islands off the southwestern coast. It is an autonomous, mostly self-governing region of Finland with its own flag. Though it has a special status, for country streaks purposes it is still counted as part of Finland.
NOTE: Åland has no Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **奧蘭**是西南部海岸外的一群島嶼。它是芬蘭一個自治、大致自治的地區，擁有自己的旗幟。雖然它擁有特殊地位，但在國家連勝（country streaks）的用途中，它仍然被算作芬蘭的一部分。
註記：奧蘭群島沒有第四代街景。

text: Each German state has their own flag. Many of them are rare to find, though.
text_zh: 德國每個邦都有自己的國旗。不過，其中許多旗幟很少見。

text: Ghana is a patriotic** **country, and you can often see things painted in the national **flag’s colours**: red, yellow, green, and sometimes including the black star.
text_zh: 迦納是一個充滿愛國情操的**國家**，你經常可以看到漆成**國旗顏色**（紅色、黃色、綠色，有時包含黑星）的物品。

text: It is somewhat common to see a small, grey flag on the antenna of Generation 3 Google cars in Hungary.
NOTE: This is also seen in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Bulgaria.
text_zh: 在匈牙利的第三代 Google 車天線上，偶爾會看到一面灰色的小旗子。
注意：這在捷克、斯洛伐克、羅馬尼亞和保加利亞也能看到。

text: **Buddhist prayer flags** are found in Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh.
text_zh: **藏傳佛教經幡**常見於錫金和阿魯納查省。

text: Lakshadweep, located off the coast of Kerala, can be easily recognised by the abundance of **coconut trees**. They are often painted **red-and-white**, resembling the Polish flag.
text_zh: 位於喀拉拉省外海的拉克沙群島，可以透過大量的**椰子樹**輕易辨認。它們經常被漆成**紅白相間**，類似波蘭國旗。

text: In Ness Ziona, There is an **Israeli flag** on house numbers.
text_zh: 在尼斯錫安納（Ness Ziona），門牌號碼上有一個**以色列國旗**。

text: Laos has a communist government. You can sometimes see red **hammer and sickle flags**.
text_zh: 寮國是共產主義政府。你偶爾可以看到紅色的**錘子與鐮刀旗**。

text: Lithuania's **historical state flag**, known as the _Vytis_, depicts a mounted knight on a dark red background. It can sometimes be seen on both private and public buildings.
text_zh: 立陶宛的**歷史國旗**（又稱 _Vytis_）描繪了紅底背景上的騎馬騎士。有時可以在私人和公共建築上看到它。

text: **State flags** can be seen with some regularity, so it is worth learning them.
text_zh: 經常可以看到**州旗**，因此很值得學習辨認它們。

text: Round metal bins, often painted green and white like the Nigerian flag, can be spotted at many rest stops and intersections.
NOTE: On some roads, the bins are blue and white.
text_zh: 在許多休息站和路口都可以看到圓形的金屬垃圾桶，通常漆成類似奈及利亞國旗的綠白相間顏色。
注意：在某些道路上，垃圾桶是藍白相間的。

text: All Dutch provinces have their own flag. However, most of these are very rarely seen in the wild. The major exceptions to this are the flags of **Friesland** and **Noord-Brabant**.
In addition, you can sometimes see the unofficial but very popular flag of the Achterhoek cultural region in the east of Gelderland.
For a full list of all provincial flags, you can view [this Wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_provinces_of_the_Netherlands).
text_zh: 荷蘭的所有省份都有自己的省旗。然而，其中大多數在現實中極少見到。主要的例外是**弗里斯蘭省**和**北布 Brabant 省**的旗幟。
此外，你偶爾可以看到位於海爾德蘭省東部的阿赫特霍克 (Achterhoek) 文化區非官方但非常受歡迎的旗幟。
如需所有省旗的完整列表，你可以查看[這個維基百科頁面](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_provinces_of_the_Netherlands)。

text: **Baarle** is a town in the south of the Netherlands which contains a number of Belgian enclaves. Throughout the town, you can sometimes see signs of this, such as markings on the pavement and [Dutch and Belgian flags](https://goo.gl/maps/sKCBPk8vqM9AUrmB9) being flown together.
text_zh: **巴勒**是荷蘭南部的一個城鎮，包含多個比利時飛地。整個城鎮中，你偶爾可以看到這類的跡象，例如路面上的標記以及同時飄揚的[荷蘭與比利時國旗](https://goo.gl/maps/sKCBPk8vqM9AUrmB9)。

text: Poland is one of the most Catholic countries in Europe. You can often find **Christian shrines** on the side of roads. Blue-white and yellow-white [Polish Catholic flags](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Catholic_flags_of_Poland) also sometimes appear.
text_zh: 波蘭是歐洲最天主教的國家之一。你經常可以在路邊找到**基督教神龕**。藍白色和黃白色的[波蘭天主教旗幟](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Catholic_flags_of_Poland)有時也會出現。

text: The regional flags of the autonomous communities are reasonably common, so it is worth learning them.
NOTE: You can practise them with [this quiz](https://www.geoguessr.com/seterra/en/fl/2033).
text_zh: 自治區的區旗相當常見，因此很值得認識它們。
注意：你可以透過[這個測驗](https://www.geoguessr.com/seterra/en/fl/2033)來練習。

text: The Catalan Independence flag is not official, but is commonly found in Catalan-speaking areas. It uses the **red-and-yellow** striped [Senyera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera) pattern that is also used in four of the autonomous community flags.
text_zh: 加泰隆尼亞獨立旗並非官方旗幟，但常見於加泰隆尼亞語地區。它採用了**紅黃相間**條紋的[塞尼耶拉](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera)圖案，該圖案也用於四個自治區旗中。

text: Most kilometre markers in Spain are either rectangular or square in shape. This can be a good clue to exclude half the country if you can see one in the distance.
There are also some unique designs.
- [Andalusian](https://goo.gl/maps/QrMQ5BpvhHxxNRFw5) markers are especially tall, featuring an extra stripe with the name of the governing body responsible for the road.
- [Madrid](https://goo.gl/maps/do335gdysTZMqevC9) markers are square and feature the regional flag at the top.
- Markers in [Biscay](https://goo.gl/maps/DHoCAAiuBc1PfdtJ9) are bigger than usual and feature a semi-circle shape at the top.
NOTE: National roads will always have a [red rectangular marker](https://goo.gl/maps/UKUGZhzmPu8iTiFX7).
text_zh: 西班牙大多數的里程碑都是長方形或正方形。如果你能在遠處看到一個，這會是排除半個國家的好線索。
這裡也有一些獨特的設計。
- [安達魯西亞](https://goo.gl/maps/QrMQ5BpvhHxxNRFw5)的里程碑特別高，帶有一條額外的橫條，標示負責該道路的管理機構名稱。
- [馬德里](https://goo.gl/maps/do335gdysTZMqevC9)的里程碑是正方形的，頂端帶有地區旗幟。
- [比斯開](https://goo.gl/maps/DHoCAAiuBc1PfdtJ9)的里程碑比一般的大，頂端呈半圓形。
注意：國道一律會有[紅色的長方形里程碑](https://goo.gl/maps/UKUGZhzmPu8iTiFX7)。

text: In most Generation 3 coverage, you will be able to see the **front of the Google car** partially through the blur: it is visible as blue-white-red patches, reminiscent of the French flag. The red patch is usually most visually distinct.
NOTE: This car is unique to Sri Lanka. Coverage in Ghana has a similar front of the car visible, but this coverage also has a roof rack.
text_zh: 在大多數第三代街景中，你將能夠透過模糊效果部分看到 **Google 車的前方**：它顯示為藍-白-紅色的色塊，讓人聯想起法國國旗。紅色色塊通常在視覺上最為明顯。
注意：這輛車是斯里蘭卡特有的。迦納的街景也有類似可見的車頭，但該街景還帶有車頂架。

text: The country is majority **Buddhist**: 70% of the population practise this religion. Throughout the country, you will often see signs of the religion, including temples, Buddha statues, [stupas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stupa) and the [Buddhist flag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag).
NOTE: Thailand, Cambodia and Laos are also majority Buddhist.
text_zh: 這個國家大多數人口信仰 **佛教**：70% 的人口實踐這種宗教。在全國各地，你經常會看到這種宗教的跡象，包括寺廟、佛像、[佛塔](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stupa) 以及 [佛教旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag)。
注意：泰國、柬埔寨和寮國也多數信仰佛教。

text: The **Swedish church flag** has a red cross on a yellow background with a crown in the middle, and is often found near churches throughout the country.
text_zh: **瑞典教會旗**是黃底紅十字，中間帶有一個皇冠，在全國各地的教堂附近經常可以看到。

text: Thailand often has many flags lining the side of its streets. Aside from the national flag, you can often see [royal flags](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_flags_of_Thailand), which are usually **yellow**.
text_zh: 泰國的街道兩側經常懸掛許多旗幟。除了國旗之外，你經常可以看到通常為**黃色**的[王室旗幟](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_flags_of_Thailand)。

text: Tunisian licence plates are **black with white text**.
NOTE: Military plates feature a small Tunisian flag on the left side of the plate, which is visible on the dark green follow car.
text_zh: 突尼西亞車牌是**黑底白字**。
注意：軍用車牌在車牌左側有一個小型突尼西亞國旗，這可以在深綠色的跟拍車上看到。

text: Ukraine uses long, white licence plates, with a distinctive **blue and yellow** strip on the left (the colours of the flag).
You may also come across older plates, where the blue and yellow are difficult to spot.
NOTE: Russia uses fully white licence plates, without a strip on the left.
text_zh: 烏干達使用長型白底車牌，左側帶有鮮明的**藍黃相間**條紋（國旗的顏色）。
你也可能會遇到較舊的車牌，其上的藍色和黃色較難辨識。
注意：俄羅斯使用全白車牌，左側沒有條紋。

text: Many random streetside objects are painted in the **colours of the Ukrainian flag**: blue and yellow. Most commonly, you will see fences that have this colour.
text_zh: 許多路邊的隨機物件都會被漆成**烏克蘭國旗的顏色**：藍色和黃色。最常見的是漆有這種顏色的柵欄。

text: On one side of the road going to Chernobyl, a **yellow flag with an Opel logo** can be seen on the Google car’s antenna.
text_zh: 在通往車諾比的道路的一側，可以在 Google 車的天線上看到一面**印有歐寶標誌的黃色旗標**。

text: Occasionally, you can find one of the **4 country flags**, which will tell you where in the UK you are.
text_zh: 有時，你可以找到其中一面**英國的 4 個國家國旗**，它會告訴你身處英國的哪個地方。

text: Each of the 50 states has its own **state flag**. These appear sometimes, but many of the more distinct looking flags will appear more often.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 50 個州各有其專屬的**州旗**。這些旗幟偶爾會出現，但許多外觀較具特色的旗幟會更常出現。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

intro.lead: 看到國旗就結束了，但要小心地區旗與商店裝飾
body: 國旗是最直接的答案，通常出現在政府機關、學校、加油站與邊境。看到就可以停止推理。
要注意三種陷阱：地區旗與州旗不等於國旗、商店常掛外國國旗做裝飾、以及國旗在風中扭曲時容易誤判相似配色（例如印尼與摩納哥、羅馬尼亞與查德）。
